description: Unit tests for the CmduServerImpl class in prplMesh, testing socket handling, message sending, receiving, and forwarding functionalities.

classes.name: CmduServerImplTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing CmduServerImpl functionalities, including socket handling and message processing.

methods.name: destructor_should_remove_remaining_connections
methods.description: Tests that the destructor properly removes event handlers for remaining socket connections.

methods.name: receive_cmdu_should_succeed
methods.description: Tests successful reception and parsing of a CMDU message from a connected socket.

methods.name: send_cmdu_should_succeed
methods.description: Tests successful sending of a CMDU message over a connected socket.

methods.name: send_cmdu_should_fail_with_invalid_cmdu
methods.description: Tests failure when attempting to send an invalid CMDU message.

methods.name: send_cmdu_should_fail_if_serialize_cmdu_fails
methods.description: Tests failure when serialization of CMDU fails during sending.

methods.name: send_cmdu_should_fail_with_disconnected_socket_fd
methods.description: Tests failure when attempting to send over a disconnected socket.

methods.name: forward_cmdu_should_succeed
methods.description: Tests successful forwarding of a CMDU message to another socket.
